title: Geometric regularity descends through faithfully flat maps
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $A\to B$ be a faithfully flat map of $k$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map]. If $B$ is geometrically regular over $k$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], then $A$ is geometrically regular over $k$.

proof.text: Fix a finite purely inseparable field extension k'/k [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]. Since A -> B is faithfully flat, the public base-change lemma [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-base-change] applied to A -> B and k -> k' gives a faithfully flat map A tensor_k k' -> B tensor_k k'. Geometric regularity of B means that B tensor_k k' is a regular ring by [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] and [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Regularity descends along this faithfully flat map by [lem-weil-pbc-regular-ring-faithfully-flat-descent], so A tensor_k k' is regular. As k'/k was arbitrary, [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] gives that A is geometrically regular over k.

split_report.summary: Split the Stacks Project proof of Algebra Lemma Tag 07NH into its finite purely inseparable base-change step. For each finite purely inseparable extension k'/k, faithful flatness of A tensor_k k' -> B tensor_k k' is supplied by the new public node lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-base-change, whose source chain is Tags 00HI, 00FI, and 00HQ. The definition of geometric regularity supplies regularity of B tensor_k k', and Tag 07NG, represented by lem-weil-pbc-regular-ring-faithfully-flat-descent, descends regularity to A tensor_k k'. The arbitrary-extension conclusion is exactly the definition in def-weil-pbc-g-ring. No Mathlib declaration captures the full geometric-regularity descent statement.
